title: EvalRecord
description: A single eval result record capturing the outcome of an autonomous task execution, including the prompt, model, score, timing, and any human interventions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this eval record (UUID v4 recommended).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for forward compatibility (semver, e.g. "1.0.0").

originalPrompt.description: The task prompt that was given to the agent.

modelVersion.description: Specific model version string for reproducibility.

attempted_model.description: HOK-2234: preserves the model attempted before fallback resolution so audits can distinguish "attempted but fell back" from "never attempted".

model_alias.description: HOK-2234: preserves the Wavemill alias for the attempted model before fallback so launch-priority coverage audits can group attempts consistently.

judgeModel.description: Model ID used by the LLM judge for this eval.

judgeProvider.description: Provider used by the LLM judge for this eval (e.g. 'anthropic').

provider.description: Execution provider for the evaluated workflow (e.g. 'deepseek').

endpoint.description: API endpoint used by the evaluated workflow when provider-specific.

score.description: Numeric score between 0 and 1 (inclusive). Preserves full granularity; use scoreBand for human-readable interpretation.

scoreBand.description: The rubric band label derived from the score.

timeSeconds.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for task completion.

phaseDurationsSeconds.description: Per-phase LLM wall-clock durations in seconds computed from workflow result artifacts.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime string when the eval was recorded.

interventionRequired.description: Whether any human intervention was required during the task.

interventionCount.description: Number of distinct human interventions during the task.

interventionDetails.description: Brief description of each human intervention (legacy - prefer interventions field).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the intervention occurred.

type.description: Type of intervention (reason for human involvement).

note.description: Human-readable description of what was done.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Optional time spent on this intervention in seconds.

rationale.description: Free-text rationale from the LLM judge explaining the score.

issueId.description: Linear issue identifier (e.g. "HOK-697"), if the task was issue-based.

challengePairId.description: Shared identifier linking both sides of a challenge-mode pair.

challengeSide.description: Side within a challenge pair, used to bind intent to evidence.

invalidChallenge.description: True when this eval record must not count as challenge/training evidence.

prUrl.description: Pull request URL, if the task produced a PR.

evaluatedPrHeadSha.description: Immutable pull request head SHA evaluated by this record.

tokenUsage.description: Token usage from the LLM judge API call.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost in USD based on the pricing table.

agentType.description: Agent that produced the work being evaluated (e.g. 'claude', 'codex').

workflowCost.description: Total estimated cost in USD to build the feature (all agent sessions on this branch).

workflowCostAttribution.description: Native workflow-cost attribution and coverage metadata.

trainingEligible.description: Whether the record includes the fields required for training export.

budgetEvalEligible.description: Whether the record includes the fields required for budget-eval export.

budgetEvalEligibilityError.description: Primary stable reason why the record is ineligible for budget-eval export.

eligibilityErrors.description: Stable machine-readable reasons why the record is ineligible for exports.

nonRewardReason.description: Stable user-readable reason why the record is not reward eligible.

quarantine_reason.description: Provenance for records quarantined during corpus hygiene migration.

failureReason.description: Stable machine-readable eval failure reason for fast-fail records.

promptSizeDiagnostic.description: Byte-size diagnostic for the eval prompt submitted or rejected.

workflowTokenUsage.description: Per-model token usage breakdown from the workflow sessions.

cacheCreationTokens.description: Tokens used to create prompt cache.

costUsd.description: Estimated cost in USD for this model.

workflowCostDiagnostics.description: Diagnostic details when workflowCost is missing or skipped.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for the workflow cost status.

worktreePath.description: Worktree path used for cost lookup, if available.

branchName.description: Branch name used for cost lookup, if available.

agentType.description: Agent type used for cost lookup, if available.

sessionFilesFound.description: Number of session files discovered during scan.

matchingTurns.description: Number of turns that matched the branch.

branchMismatches.description: Number of scanned turns rejected due to branch mismatch.

enrichmentDiagnostics.description: List of enrichment metadata fields still missing after shared training-record enrichment.

pricingSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the pricing table used for workflowCost calculation (HOK-858). Maps model IDs to their pricing at the time of evaluation.

inputCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens.

outputCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens.

cacheWriteCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache creation (write) input tokens.

cacheReadCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache read input tokens.

modelIdentityAttribution.description: Observation-time model identity snapshot for executed and candidate model references.

normalizedEvaluationCost.description: Promotion-time normalized cost computed from final explicit pricing without mutating observed cost.

difficultyBand.description: Difficulty band classification derived from signals.

difficultySignals.description: Quantifiable difficulty metrics computed from PR data.

filesTouched.description: Number of files modified in the PR.

moduleHotspotScore.description: Module hotspot score based on git history (optional).

diffUncertain.description: True when diff parsing returned suspicious results (e.g. 0 LOC with files present).

routingDecision.description: Routing decision metadata capturing all candidates considered (required if training routing models).

candidates.description: All candidate configurations that were eligible for this task.

chosen.description: The chosen candidate (full object or index into candidates array).

decisionPolicyVersion.description: Decision policy version that made this choice (e.g., 'baseline', 'router-v1.0').

decisionRationale.description: Optional rationale or top features used for the decision.

routeMode.description: Route strategy used to produce the underlying workflow route.

routeArtifactSchemaVersion.description: Stable version identifier for route artifact structure.

policyResolverVersion.description: Stable version identifier for policy resolution logic.

operatingModeDependency.description: Whether quota operating mode constrained the route independently of policy source.

promptArtifacts.description: Prompt artifacts used during workflow execution.

stageOutcomes.description: Per-stage quality attribution for GEPA training.

taskContext.description: Task context metadata for routing and evaluation (HOK-774).

changeKind.description: Whether the task modifies existing code, creates new code, or both.

constraints.description: Special constraints that apply to this task.

hasStrictStyle.description: Whether the task requires strict adherence to a style guide.

mustNotTouchX.description: Whether the task has modules/files that must not be touched.

timeboxed.description: Whether the task is timeboxed with a deadline.

noNetAccess.description: Whether the task must be completed without network access.

filesTouchedEstimate.description: Estimated number of files to be touched.

expectedLoCChange.description: Estimated lines of code to be changed.

oneOf.description: Whether domain knowledge is required (boolean form).

repoContext.description: Repository context metadata for routing and evaluation (HOK-774).

repoId.description: Stable identifier for the repository (hash or slug).

repoVisibility.description: Whether the repository is open source or private.

fileCount.description: Total number of files in the repository.

loc.description: Total lines of code in the repository.

monorepo.description: Whether the repository is a monorepo.

constraints.description: Budget constraints applied during routing and execution.

outcomes.description: Decomposed outcome components for granular eval analysis.

success.description: Hard gate: whether the task succeeded (derived from score).

ran.description: Whether CI checks were triggered for this PR.

added.description: Whether new test files were added in this PR.

passRate.description: Test pass rate (0-1), if test results are available.

durationSeconds.description: Total test execution time in seconds, if available.

lintDelta.description: Change in lint errors (negative = improvement, positive = regression).

review.description: Human review activity on the PR.

humanReviewRequired.description: Whether human review was required (any review comments or changes requested).

rounds.description: Number of distinct review submission rounds.

rework.description: Agent rework and failures during implementation.

agentIterations.description: Number of agent iterations (session turns, commits, or retries).

toolFailures.description: Number of tool/API call failures, if tracked.

timeToMergeSeconds.description: Time from PR creation to merge in seconds, if merged.

taskDescriptor.description: Task descriptor for router training (HOK-1120). Consolidates generalizable task features into a privacy-safe structure.

heuristic.description: Heuristic signals derived from task prompt and PR diff.

files_touched.description: Number of files modified in the PR.

repo_size_loc.description: Repository size in lines of code.

description_tokens.description: Approximate token count of task description.

is_greenfield.description: Whether the task creates new code (vs modifying existing).

has_migration.description: Whether the task involves a database migration.

has_ui.description: Whether the task has UI components.

has_tests.description: Whether the task adds or modifies tests.

cross_service.description: Whether the task spans multiple services.

learned.description: Learned signals that require classification or embedding.

risk_flags.description: Risk flags detected in the task.

embedding_id.description: Optional vector store reference for nearest-neighbor lookup.

constraints.description: Constraints and objectives for task execution.

models_available.description: Models available for routing consideration. Historical records may contain an empty array, but the write path rejects empty values.

objective.description: Routing objective (maximize success, minimize cost, or balanced).

model.description: Model identifier used for this stage.

score.description: Quality score 0-1 for this stage (null pre-eval).

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD for this stage.

time_minutes.description: Time spent on this stage in minutes.

rubric.description: Rubric-derived features for router training (HOK-1409). NN-ready: bounded numeric features only, no free text.

outcome.description: Overall task outcome summary (null when used as router input pre-eval).

fallbackEvent.description: Cross-model fallback telemetry for quota-aware training attribution.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the fallback event payload.

preferred_model.description: Model preferred before any fallback occurred.

fallback_model.description: Model that ultimately produced the response, or null if none succeeded.

task_type.description: Task type used to select the fallback ladder.

difficulty.description: Difficulty classification supplied by the caller, when known.

quota_snapshot.description: Quota-state snapshot captured near the fallback event.

snapshotAt.description: Timestamp when the quota snapshot was read.

models.description: Per-model quota entries at snapshot time.

status.description: Current quota status for the model.

resetAt.description: When quota is expected to recover, if known.

human_intervention.description: Whether a human manually intervened in the fallback path.

outcome.description: Final outcome of the fallback sequence.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end wall-clock duration across the fallback sequence.

cost_usd.description: Observed cost in USD across the fallback sequence, if surfaced.

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of models that failed before success or terminal exit.

reason.description: Reason that the model was skipped or failed.

manifestRef.description: Reference to the per-run resource manifest used for this workflow.

rubricEval.description: Structured rubric criteria evaluation from the judge. Captures per-criterion scores as durable training signal. Present only for records produced after schema v1.10.0.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this rubricEval shape.

rubric_version.description: Semantic rubric version; bumped when criteria or boundaries change meaningfully.

determinative_boundary.description: Which scoring boundary was the binding constraint on the final score.

rubric_provenance.description: Provenance of the rubric metadata attached to this eval record.

challengeRouteContext.description: Challenge-mode routing context preserving bootstrap and expanded route provenance when available.

routeProvenance.description: General routing provenance capturing bootstrap, expanded, and active execution routes for eval attribution.

executedPlanning.description: Authoritative planning execution provenance loaded from .planning-result.json.

verificationTelemetry.description: CI-derived pre-PR verification telemetry from HOK-2603 and HOK-2604.

source.description: How the verification contract was sourced.

version.description: Semantic version of the verification contract.

head.description: HEAD commit SHA when verification ran.

passed.description: Whether all local verification commands passed.

first_failure_index.description: Index of the first failing command, if any.

first_failure_fingerprint.description: Content hash of failed check output after redaction.

first_failure_category.description: Automated category of the first local failure.

total_duration_ms.description: Total time for all verification commands in milliseconds.

remote_ci_verdict.description: First CI run result from remote CI classification.

passed_before_merge.description: Whether CI passed at some point before PR merge.

first_failure_check.description: Name of the first failing check.

first_failure_category.description: Automated category of the first remote failure.

first_failure_fingerprint.description: Content hash of failed check output after redaction.

remote_only_failure.description: True if CI failed after local verification passed.

remediation.description: Repair actions taken before or after PR creation.

local_attempt_count.description: Number of times local verification was re-run.

remote_fix_required.description: Whether remote CI required follow-up fixes.

remote_fix_commits.description: Number of follow-up commits to fix remote CI.

operator_override.description: Human operator override of the verification gate.

timeline.description: Key timing points in the verification lifecycle.

pr_created.description: When PR was created after verification.

remote_ci_start.description: When first remote CI run started.

workflow_success_rate_under_budget.description: Wavemill router benchmark score: successful completions that stayed under budget.

featureOutcomeDiagnostics.description: Diagnostics for the feature-outcome artifact consumption path (HOK-2262).

present.description: Whether a feature-state or feature-outcome artifact file was found on disk.

valid.description: Whether the artifact was parseable and had a valid outcome object.

used.description: Whether the artifact was actually used (valid and all required fields present).

sourceFile.description: Basename of the resolved artifact file.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the raw artifact bytes.

schemaVersion.description: schemaVersion field from the artifact root.

reason.description: Reason for the current diagnostic state.

normalizedFields.description: Normalized outcome fields from the artifact.

missingFields.description: Keys that were absent from the artifact outcome object.

invalidFields.description: Keys that were present but had unexpected types.

eligibilityDiagnostic.description: Machine-readable eligibility classification from the artifact.

conflictsWithReconstruction.description: True when at least one field conflicts with the reconstructed outcome.

conflictingFields.description: Names of fields that differ between artifact and reconstruction.

metadata.description: Optional extensibility bag for additional metadata.

routing.description: Resolved-model routing decisions for planner/coder/reviewer launches.

harnessId.description: Stable harness content hash for the behavior-relevant manifest resources.

inheritedStages.description: Stages this arm inherited from pre-fork execution (HOK-2794).
Stages this arm inherited from pre-fork execution (HOK-2794).

challengeRecommendation.description: Free-form router recommendation that selected or skipped a challenge.

forkStage.description: The stage at which the pair forked, or null if launched independently (HOK-2794).

forkCommit.description: Git SHA both arms share, or null if the pair did not fork from a shared commit (HOK-2794).

sharedPrefix.description: Whether the challenger inherited pre-fork execution artifacts. False until challenge.fork() ships (HOK-2794).

harnessId.description: Stable harness content hash for the behavior-relevant manifest resources.
Stable harness content hash for the behavior-relevant manifest resources.

RubricCriterion.description: A single structured per-stage rubric criterion from the eval judge.

score.description: Normalized score 0.0-1.0 for this stage criterion.

notes.description: Optional brief explanation from the judge.

ChallengeStageEvidenceItem.description: Normalized evidence item for planner/reviewer challenge comparison.

ChallengeStageEval.description: First-class planner/reviewer stage evidence for challenge evals.

StageScore.description: Per-stage quality attribution from the eval judge.

RubricCriterionScore.description: Score and rationale for a single rubric criterion.
